generates.description: List of model generation settings for each Kintone app.

apiToken.description: API token for accessing the Kintone app.

className.description: Optional class name override. If null, the default naming (App{appId}) is used.

useRecord.description: Generate C# record types instead of classes.

pureMode.description: Generate pure POCO models without Kintone-specific attributes.

outputDirectory.description: Output directory for generated files (relative paths are resolved from the kmodel execution directory).

overwriteExistingFiles.description: Whether to overwrite existing files in the output directory.

raws.description: List of raw metadata export settings for each Kintone app.

apiToken.description: API token for accessing the Kintone app.

outputDirectory.description: Output directory for raw metadata files.

overwriteExistingFiles.description: Whether to overwrite existing raw files.
